fusions.name: Catching Light
fusions.desc: Snaps a burning tip into the first enemy it meets, which deals 12 damage and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hoop of Flame
fusions.desc: Whirls the burning lash in a full circle that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignores their resistances and sets each [Burning] for 4 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scorched Line
fusions.desc: Drags the burning lash across the ground and leaves a line of flame 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sparks Off the Cracker
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a spark flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, deals 7 damage and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, then leaps to 2 more within 3 tiles for 50% of that. Once every 6 seconds.
